0.name: Attack Loadouts Unlocked
0.description: How many attack bar pages every character has: 2 at the start, 3 from the first time you enter map 154 (Outskirts of Fallstar Isle). The attack bar arrows and the 7/8 keys cycle through them.

1.name: Storage Chest - Quick Deposit
1.description: 1 = with the storage chest open, one tap on an inventory item moves it into the chest. Turning it off also turns off Quick Withdraw (slot 18).

2.name: Storage Chest - Button Panel Open
2.description: 1 = the storage chest's side panel of buttons is slid out, 0 = tucked away. Opens by itself once for a new account (first character level 6 to 11).

3.name: Shop - Quick Tap
3.description: 1 = buy and sell in shops by clicking items, no dragging. Turns off every time a map loads.

4.name: Shop - Quick Tap Tip Seen
4.description: 1 once you've turned on shop Quick Tap for the first time and the shopkeeper's one-time line has played.

5.name: Talent Points Per Click
5.description: How many talent points one click adds: cycles 1, 5, 10, 25, 900 (900 shows as MAX).

6.name: Talent Points Per Click Unlocked
6.description: 1 once a character above level 25 has loaded a map. Shows the points-per-click button on the talent page.

7.name: Spiketrap Surprise - Daily Gems
7.description: Daily gem run of the Spiketrap Surprise minigame. 1 = today's run is ready, 0 = used. After a run it holds the gems won (up to 40); they drop at the next map load and it goes back to 0.

8.name: Chat Window X Position
8.description: Chat window's distance from the left edge of the screen, in pixels. Set by dragging the window.

9.name: Chat Window Y Position
9.description: Chat window's distance from the top of the screen, in pixels. Set by dragging the window.

10.name: Chat Window Width
10.description: Chat window width step, 0 to 2. Each step makes it 50 pixels wider.

11.name: Chat Window Height
11.description: Chat window height step, 0 to 2. Each step makes it 40 pixels taller.

13.name: Chat Option (Account Copy)
13.description: Account-wide copy of the Options menu's chat toggle (character option 21). When 1, that option turns on for every character above level 10.

14.name: Original Gamer Trophy Received
14.description: 1 once the account has been given the Original Gamer trophy (only while the game's server turns that giveaway on).

15.name: Unclaimed W1 Colosseum Ticket Days
15.description: Number of unclaimed W1 colosseum ticket days. Goes up by 1 each day; claiming gives up to 3 tickets and resets it to 0.

16.name: Unclaimed W1 Boss Keys Days
16.description: Number of unclaimed W1 boss keys days. Goes up by 1 each day; claiming gives up to 3 keys and resets it to 0.

17.name: Character List - Show Time Away
17.description: 1 = the character list shows how long each character has been away ("Currently Playing!" for the one you're on). Toggled by a button at the top right of that menu.

18.name: Storage Chest - Quick Withdraw
18.description: 1 = one tap on a storage chest item moves it to your inventory. Turning it on also turns on Quick Deposit (slot 1).

19.name: Task - Maximum Efficiency Progress
19.description: Progress text for the W2 task "Maximum Efficiency": the skills that already meet the efficiency goal, written like ".0.|.3.|". Goes back to "none.|" when the task moves on.

20.name: Rate Game Prompt
20.description: Set to 1 when the game's server asks players to rate the game again; 10 opts out. Nothing in this game version reads the 1, so no prompt comes from it.

21.name: Anvil Production Tab Seen
21.description: 1 once you've opened the Anvil's Production tab. Until then its tab button blinks.

22.name: Chat - Last Server Message Read
22.description: The text of the last server announcement you've seen in chat. A newer one marks the Server tab as unread.

23.name: Forge - Quick Tap
23.description: 1 = with the forge open, one tap moves items between your inventory and the forge, no dragging.

24.name: Unused
24.description: Not used by the game: nothing reads or writes it beyond filling empty slots with 0.

25.name: Seasonal Event Item Counter opened
25.description: Tracks collected event items opened (coolers, presents, baskets)

26.name: Shadowban
26.description: 0 = not flagged. Any other number is the game's cheat flag; the number says why (1 too-high level or stats, 4 too many gems, 7 and 8 other checks). While set, guild joins and some online features are blocked. The game also tells its server when it sets or clears this; editing the number here does not.
26.warning: Modifying this may affect your account status

29.name: Event Boxes Dropped Today
29.description: Event boxes monsters have dropped today, out of 50. Drops stop at 50; goes back to 0 each day.

30.name: Bolt Cutters Used
30.description: 1 once you've used Bolt Cutters in the last Sewers map (map 9), which opens its secret entrance.

31.name: Unclaimed W2 Boss Keys Days
31.description: Number of unclaimed W2 boss keys days. Goes up by 1 each day; claiming gives up to 3 keys and resets it to 0.

32.name: Ivory Bubble Cauldrons
32.description: One digit per bubble cauldron (4); 1 = that cauldron has the gem shop's Ivory upgrade: +2 players, 1.5x brewing and 1.5x new bubble chance.

33.name: Minigame Plays Left
33.description: Minigame plays you have left. Refilled each day; each play uses at least 1.

34.name: Quick Ref View-Only Lock
34.description: 1 while a menu opened from the Quick Ref page is view-only (the storage chest without the right pet, and one other menu). Item moves and purchases show a popup instead. Goes back to 0 when menus close.

35.name: Unclaimed W2 Colosseum Ticket Days
35.description: Number of unclaimed W2 colosseum ticket days. Goes up by 1 each day; claiming gives up to 3 tickets and resets it to 0.

36.name: Hide Guild Name
36.description: Account-wide copy of the Options menu toggle for your guild name (character option 26). 0 shows your guild name under your character, 1 hides it.

37.name: Guild Name
37.description: Your guild name, as the game's server sends it. Empty when you're not in a guild.

38.name: Guild Icon Index
38.description: Which icon your guild uses, as the game's server sends it.

39.name: Days Until Weekly Reset
39.description: Days left until the weekly reset (Killroy rooms, the weekly storage chest reward and other weekly upgrades). Counts down each day and starts again at 6.

40.name: Star Sign Progress
40.description: Tracks progress in star sign constellation system

41.name: Guild Giftboxes Waiting
41.description: Guild Giftboxes still to hand out this week. Each week it is set to 2 plus the Guild Gifts bonus, then the boxes go into your storage chest when it has room.

42.name: Old Account Gift Owed
42.description: 1 = this account is owed a one-time gift from an old update: 3 Sub Class Swap Tokens and 5 Post Office Box Reseto Magnificos, given on load when the inventory has room.

43.name: Unused
43.description: Not read or written by the game. Only touched by the loops that fill empty slots with 0.

44.name: Daily Gem Days Left
44.description: Days of 350 free gems left from gem shop packs. Each daily reset gives 350 gems and lowers it by 1. The Starter Pack adds 4 days.

45.name: Starter Pack Offer Timer
45.description: Seconds on the Starter Pack offer clock. The shop offers the pack while this is under 172800 (2 days); it counts up while slot 46 is 1, offline time too. Buying the pack sets it to 259201.

46.name: Starter Pack Timer On
46.description: 1 = the Starter Pack offer clock (slot 45) is running. Turned on the first time the gem shop shows the pack, or by the daily reset for accounts with few bought gems.

47.name: Critters Unlocked
47.description: How many critters you can trap. Raised by the Lord of the Hunt quests and later unlocks, up to 11.

48.name: Character Select View
48.description: Which view the character select screen uses (0 or 1), switched by a button there. The button appears once your first character is over level 15.

49.name: Starter Pack Reset Version
49.description: The last StarterBundleReset number from the server. When the server number changes and you have not bought the Starter Pack, its offer clock starts over.

50.name: Master Volume
50.description: Overall volume slider, 0 to 100. Sounds stay off while it is 0. New accounts start at 45.

51.name: Music Volume
51.description: Music volume slider, 0 to 100. New accounts start at 47.

52.name: Sound Effects Volume
52.description: Sound effects volume slider, 0 to 100. New accounts start at 39.

53.name: Steam Welcome Gift
53.description: 83734 once the Steam welcome gift was given during a Steam event. The rate-the-game popup also writes 1 or 3 here, but that popup no longer opens.

54.name: Unused
54.description: Not read or written by the game. Only touched by the loops that fill empty slots with 0.

55.name: Library Checkouts
55.description: Talent book checkouts waiting in the library. One more is added each time the timer fills, and each one waiting makes the next slower. Checking out a book uses them.

56.name: Unclaimed W3 Colosseum Ticket Days
56.description: Days of free colosseum tickets waiting in World 3. One more each day. Claiming gives up to 3 tickets and resets it to 0.

57.name: Giant Mobs This Week
57.description: Giant monsters spawned this week. Each one makes the next less likely. Resets weekly.

58.name: Construction Building Info
58.description: On/off switch at the top right of the Construction buildings screen. When 1, each building shows its upgrade cost and build progress bar.

59.name: Unused
59.description: Not read or written by the game. Only touched by the loops that fill empty slots with 0.

60.name: Gem Shop Popup Seen
60.description: Which gem shop pack popup was shown last, like "bun_c". Set to "non" by the daily reset for accounts with few bought gems, so a popup can show again.

61.name: Favorite Server
61.description: The server marked as favorite in the server list, as its number plus 1 (0 = none). Play joins it instead of a random server.

62.name: Bargain Tags
62.description: Bargain Tags held. Each one takes 25% off the next bubble upgrade, up to 90% off. All are used on that upgrade.

63.name: Rate Prompt Version
63.description: The last RateAgain number from the server. When it changes, the game resets the rate-the-game state in slot 20, unless that slot is 10.

64.name: Unused
64.description: Not read or written by the game. Only touched by the loops that fill empty slots with 0.

65.name: Old Gem Gift Tier
65.description: Read only by an old one-time update, which gave 200, 160, 120 or 100 gems for values 1, 3, 2 or 4. Nothing writes it.

66.name: YouTube Button Gems Claimed
66.description: 12 once the YouTube button gave its 60 gems. The button shows on the HUD when the server turns it on and your first character is over level 14.

67.name: Event Box Card Today
67.description: 2 once today's first event box opened during an event also dropped a random card. Back to 0 at the daily reset.

68.name: DO NOT TOUCH
68.description: Cheater flag. When 1, gem items give no gems and show "You've been caught cheating", and your Tome score is no longer sent.
68.warning: DO NOT MODIFY - Will trigger shadowban

69.name: Statue Tools Used
69.description: Which tools you gave the statue man: 1 Guilding Tools (golden statues), 2 Onyx Tools (onyx statues), 3 Zenith Tools (zenith statues).

70.name: Alchemy Button Clicked
70.description: Set by a button at the top of the Alchemy menu: 1 after a click on the first tab, 2 on the second, 3 on both. Nothing uses the value any more.

71.name: Dungeon Credits (Blue) - Total
71.description: All blue dungeon credits ever earned. Sets your dungeon rank.

72.name: Dungeon Credits (Blue) - Actual
72.description: Blue dungeon credits you can spend in a dungeon hub.

73.name: Dungeon Credits (Pink/Flurbos)
73.description: Flurbo dungeon credits you can spend in a dungeon hub.

74.name: Arcade Balls (Normal)
74.description: Arcade balls. Each arcade launch uses one.

75.name: Arcade Balls (Golden)
75.description: Golden arcade balls. Spent on arcade shop upgrades.

76.name: Dungeon Passes
76.description: Dungeon passes. The dungeon shows this minus 1. Each week adds 12 (more with the gem shop upgrade), and each run uses some. At 0, dungeon loot drops less often.

77.name: Unlimited Dungeon Pass Days
77.description: Days of unlimited dungeon passes. While above 0, runs use no passes. Goes down by 1 each day.

78.name: New Stuff Seen
78.description: The last NewStuffButton number from the server you have seen. While it differs, the sixth main menu button wiggles until you open it.

79.name: Starter Pack Popup Shown
79.description: 1.7 once the Starter Pack popup slid in on a town map. It slides in only once.

80.name: Chizoar's Cavern Keys Waiting (Days)
80.description: Days of Chizoar's Cavern Keys (World 3 boss key) waiting for you. Goes up by 1 each day. Talking to Bellows or the quick-access board gives you up to 3 keys and sets it back to 0.

81.name: Cosmic Time Candy Pity Counter
81.description: Luck counter for Cosmic Time Candy. A roll of 100+ hours sets it to 15, every smaller roll lowers it by 1. At 1 or less, each candy has a 1 in 3 chance of 100 to 250 hours.

82.name: Old Update Marker
82.description: Set once to -6.3 by an old game update. Nothing in the game reads it.

83.name: Auto Loot Off
83.description: Auto loot switch from the quick-access board: 0 = on, 1 = off. Only works once you own the Auto Loot gem shop bundle; buying it sets 0.

84.name: Unused
84.description: Not read or written by the game. Only touched by the generic "fill missing slots with 0" loops.

85.name: Breeding Territories Unlocked
85.description: How many Breeding territories you have beaten. Winning a new territory fight raises it; it unlocks the next territory and the Mutated Mush days (slot 98).

86.name: Breeding Failure Streak
86.description: Breeds in a row without a new or shiny Mob. Feeds the 5th Breeding Multi (Failure) from the Failsafe Restitution Cloud upgrade, up to that upgrade's max. Goes back to 0 when you get a new Mob.

87.name: Egg Incubator Progress
87.description: Seconds of progress toward the next egg in the Breeding incubator. Goes up with time (also offline time and time candy); each full egg time spent makes an egg.

88.name: Arena Attempt Ready
88.description: 1 = today's Breeding Arena fight is ready. Set to 1 at each daily reset; starting the Arena fight sets 0 (unless a bonus keeps it). While 0, the Arena shows the time until reset.

89.name: Arena Best Round
89.description: Best round you have beaten in the Breeding Arena (normal mode). Arena bonuses unlock at set rounds.

90.name: Fence Yard Eggs Laid
90.description: Eggs laid by Eggshell Mobs in the Fence Yard, waiting to be picked up (max 10). They drop when you enter the Fence Yard, which sets it back to 0.

91.name: Chip Repository Unlock
91.description: 0 = locked. 1 = Chip Repository unlocked (hold 3 Piles of Processor Chips). 2 = Jewel Spinner also unlocked (hold 7 Strung Jewels), which shows the extra chip and jewel slots.

92.name: 4-Star Cardifiers
92.description: Cardifiers you own, bought in the gem shop. Each one raises a 3-star card to 4 stars.

93.name: Dungeon Weekly Big Run Ready
93.description: 1 = this week's big Dungeon run is unused: a full party (3+) in the hourly bonus window uses up to 20 passes at once for that many times the rewards. Using it sets 0, after that it's 3x at most until the weekly reset sets 1.

94.name: Keychain Fragments
94.description: Keychain Fragments on your account, spent on keychains at the Keychain Pile. Holding Keychain Fragment items adds them here; gem shop packs add 40, 120 or 300.

95.name: Free Town Teleports
95.description: 1 = you used the Bottled World Town Teleport, so teleporting between world towns is free.

96.name: Dilapidated Slush Days
96.description: Days of snow built up at the Refrigeration Station (World 3), +1 a day once Construction is unlocked. Above 3, dropping a Bucket of Slush there spawns up to 10 Dilapidated Slush minibosses and sets it to 0.

97.name: Patch Notes Seen
97.description: Number of the last patch notes you opened.

98.name: Mutated Mush Days
98.description: Days of build-up for the Mutated Mush, +1 a day once a Breeding territory is beaten. Above 3, an oil barrel drop on its World 4 map spawns up to 8 Mutated Mush minibosses and sets it to 0.

99.name: Trapping Minigame Best Score
99.description: Best score in the Trapping minigame. Every 25 points unlocks one of 9 bonuses (all at 225); it also counts toward the Tome.

100.name: Spice Claims Used Today
100.description: Breeding spice claims used today. Each claim adds 1 until the daily limit. Resets each day to 0 minus 25 for each Trasher Mob in the Fence Yard, so it can start below 0.

101.name: Crystal Mobs Spawned Today
101.description: Crystal Mobs spawned today. While it's below your guaranteed amount, every kill spawns one. Resets to 0 each day; Killroy's skull shop item lowers it by 1 (so it can go below 0).

102.name: Dev Event Rewards Today
102.description: How many rewards the game developer gave you today through live in-game chat events (spawned monsters, gems and so on). Stops at 10; resets each day.

103.name: Starter Guide Progress
103.description: Step of Lava's new-player guide bar (0 to 7). -1 = finished or hidden; -2 jumps to 7 on the next load. An old update set -1 on every account.

104.name: Starter Guide Collapsed
104.description: 1 = Lava's new-player guide bar starts collapsed. Only matters while the guide is active (slot 103 at 0 or more).

105.name: Killroy Skulls
105.description: Skulls to spend in Killroy's skull shop. Killroy fights drop them; each week they reset to your Armory bonus amount.

106.name: Killroy Upgrade 1 - Timer
106.description: Level of Killroy's 1st upgrade. A Killroy run lasts 100 + level seconds.

107.name: Killroy Upgrade 2 - Talent Point Drops
107.description: Level of Killroy's 2nd upgrade. With at least 1 level, Killroy kills can drop Talent Points; each level raises the chance by 5%. Shown after 2 finished runs.

108.name: Killroy Upgrade 3 - Bonus Skulls
108.description: Level of Killroy's 3rd upgrade. Raises the skull drop chance in Killroy runs by 1% per level. Shown after 16 finished runs.
108.warning: Do not set if you haven't unlocked this upgrade yet

109.name: Killroy Upgrade 4 - Respawn
109.description: Level of Killroy's 4th upgrade. Each spawn wave in a Killroy run has a level% chance of one extra monster. Shown after 36 finished runs.
109.warning: Do not set if you haven't unlocked this upgrade yet

110.name: Killroy Upgrade 5 - Dungeon Credit Drops
110.description: Level of Killroy's 5th upgrade. Killroy monsters drop Dungeon Credits with chance 1% x (1 + level/100). Shown after 64 finished runs.
110.warning: Do not set if you haven't unlocked this upgrade yet

111.name: Killroy Upgrade 6 - Pearl Drops
111.description: Level of Killroy's 6th upgrade. Killroy monsters drop a Black, Holy or Divinity Pearl with chance 0.2% x (1 + level/100). Shown after 100 finished runs.
111.warning: Do not set if you haven't unlocked this upgrade yet

112.name: Killroy Runs Total
112.description: Total finished Killroy runs. Upgrade rows unlock at 2, 16, 36, 64 and 100 runs.

113.name: Killroy Fights Done This Week
113.description: Which weekly Killroy fights you've started, as digits: fight 1 adds 1, fight 2 adds 20, fight 3 adds 300 (so 21 = fights 1 and 2). Resets to 0 each week or with the Airhorn.

114.name: Killroy Talent Points Found
114.description: Talent Points found in Killroy runs, all time. Each one makes the next rarer. They cycle through Tabs 1 to 4, with every 9th a Special Tab point.

115.name: Killroy Airhorn Used
115.description: 1 = this week's Airhorn is used (400 gems to redo all weekly Killroy fights). Resets to 0 each week.

116.name: Unused
116.description: Not read or written by the game. Only touched by the generic "fill missing slots with 0" loops.

117.name: Breeding Worlds Unlocked
117.description: How many worlds of Mobs you can breed (at least 3). Beating the World 4, 5 or 6 boss sets it to 4.

118.name: Gem Shop Limited Offer Seen
118.description: Number of the last limited-time gem shop offer you were shown. When the server has a new one, the game shows the gem shop popup once and stores the new number.

119.name: World 5 Portal Restored
119.description: 1 = you gave the Architect Toucan the Magma Geode, so the World 4 town portal to World 5 works.

120.name: Idle Skilling Codes Claimed
120.description: How many Idle Skilling reward codes you've claimed (0 to 10). Codes are typed in chat and must be claimed in order.

121.name: Idle Skilling Code Wait Days
121.description: Days to wait before the next Idle Skilling code works. Goes down by 1 each day; 0 or less means ready.

122.name: Unused
122.description: Not read or written by the game. Only touched by the generic 'fill missing slots with 0' loops.

123.name: Draconic Liquid Cauldrons
123.description: How many of the 4 liquid cauldrons are Draconic (0 to 4). The gem shop stops selling them at 4.

124.name: Sailing Bonus Time
124.description: Banked sailing time in seconds, from AFK bonuses and items. It plays out fast while the Sailing menu is open; you can't leave the menu while it's over 100.

125.name: Gold Relic Days
125.description: Days counted by the Gold Relic artifact, up to 40 (more at higher artifact tiers). Each day makes 3D printer samples 2% bigger; taking a sample resets it.

126.name: Giants Eye Shiny Bonus
126.description: Bonus % to shiny pet breeding chance from the Giants Eye artifact. Grows each day; resets to 0 when you breed a shiny.

127.name: Arrowhead Chest Filter
127.description: Lowest sailing chest rarity your captains bring back (0 to 4; 0 keeps all). Set with the Arrowhead artifact button in Sailing.

128.name: Found Items Cleanup Done
128.description: Set to 7 after a one-time fix that removes gems, cards, spices and other non-Slab items from your found-items list.

129.name: Talent Preset Hint Done
129.description: 1 once you've used talent presets. Until then the Talents page points at the preset button for level 30+ characters.

130.name: Attack Bar Hint Done
130.description: 1 once you've put a talent on your attack bar. Until then the Talents page shows hint arrows.

131.name: Bonus Post Office Boxes
131.description: Extra Post Office box points, added to the ones from deliveries. They come from some sailing artifacts, the Beryllium atom (turns silver pens into boxes) and daily box bonuses.

132.name: Atom Collider On
132.description: Atom Collider switch, 1 = on. While on, storage stacks over the threshold (slot 133) turn into particles.

133.name: Atom Collider Threshold
133.description: Storage amount the Atom Collider keeps: 0 = 15M, 1 = 25M, 2 = 100M, 3 = 250M, 4 = 1.05B.

134.name: Hydrogen Stamp Days
134.description: Days counted by the Hydrogen atom. Stamp max-level upgrades get cheaper each day, up to 90%; upgrading any stamp's max level resets it.

135.name: Boron Particle Upgrades Left
135.description: Bubble upgrades you can still pay for with particles today (Boron atom). Refills each day.

136.name: Last Read Lava Message
136.description: Text of the last message from Lava you've seen. When the server has a new one, characters level 25+ get a notice.

137.name: Random Event Done Today
137.description: 1 once you've beaten today's random event boss. Random events stop showing until the daily reset.

138.name: Orb of Remembrance Kills
138.description: Kills of monsters marked by the Divine Knight's Orb of Remembrance. Boosts King of the Remembered.

139.name: Pirate Flag Kills
139.description: Kills counted by the Siege Breaker's Pirate Flag. Boosts Archlord of the Pirates.

140.name: Key: Jump / Rope / Portal
140.description: Key code for jump, ropes and portals (default 87 = W). Set it in the game's keybind menu so the shown letter (slot 146) matches.

141.name: Key: Jump Down
141.description: Key code for dropping down (default 83 = S). Set it in the game's keybind menu so the shown letter (slot 147) matches.

142.name: Key: Move Left
142.description: Key code for moving left (default 65 = A). Set it in the game's keybind menu so the shown letter (slot 148) matches.

143.name: Key: Move Right
143.description: Key code for moving right (default 68 = D). Set it in the game's keybind menu so the shown letter (slot 149) matches.

144.name: Key: Interact / Talk
144.description: Key code for interacting and talking (default 69 = E). Set it in the game's keybind menu so the shown letter (slot 150) matches.

145.name: Key: Attack
145.description: Key code for attacking (default 82 = R). Set it in the game's keybind menu so the shown letter (slot 151) matches.

146.name: Key Label: Jump / Rope / Portal
146.description: Text shown for slot 140's key in the keybind menu (default "W"). Display only.

147.name: Key Label: Jump Down
147.description: Text shown for slot 141's key in the keybind menu (default "S"). Display only.

148.name: Key Label: Move Left
148.description: Text shown for slot 142's key in the keybind menu (default "A"). Display only.

149.name: Key Label: Move Right
149.description: Text shown for slot 143's key in the keybind menu (default "D"). Display only.

150.name: Key Label: Interact / Talk
150.description: Text shown for slot 144's key in the keybind menu (default "E"). Display only.

151.name: Key Label: Attack
151.description: Text shown for slot 145's key in the keybind menu (default "R"). Display only.

152.name: Dimensional Wormhole Kills
152.description: Kills of monsters from the Elemental Sorcerer's Dimensional Wormhole. Boosts Wormhole Emperor.

153.name: Language
153.description: Game language, 1 to 7. 0 means not picked yet, and the game asks for it.

154.name: Gilded Stamps
154.description: Gilded stamps you have. Each takes 95% off one stamp upgrade. You get them by chance each day from the Rift bonus.

155.name: 5-Star Cards
155.description: Cards raised to 5 stars with a 5-Star Cardifier, as card IDs separated by commas.

156.name: 5-Star Cardifiers
156.description: 5-Star Cardifiers left. Each one raises a 4-star card to 5 stars.

157.name: Auto-Move Hint Done
157.description: 1 once you've turned on auto-move while on map 1. Until then a hint for it shows on that map.

158.name: Void Trial Best Portals
158.description: Most portals opened in one Void Walker trial run; boss kills count too. Void Trial Rerun and Master of the System use it.

159.name: Sailing Exploit Fix Flag
159.description: Set to 1 if an old one-time patch found exploited sailing numbers on this account and reset them. Nothing reads it now.

160.name: Trash Island Garbage Days
160.description: Days of garbage piled up on Trash Island. Goes up by 1 each day; visiting the island drops the garbage and sets it back to 0.

161.name: Garbage
161.description: Garbage held. Picked up on Trash Island and spent in the Garbage Tuna's shop there.

162.name: Bottles
162.description: Bottles held. Picked up at the docks and spent on maps to new islands and on Rando Island upgrades.

163.name: Trash Island Garbage Upgrade
163.description: Level of the Trash Island upgrade that gives more Garbage from the daily pile. Bought with Garbage; each level costs 1.4x more.

164.name: Trash Island Bottle Upgrade
164.description: Level of the Trash Island upgrade that gives +10% Bottles per level from each bottle at the docks. Bought with Garbage; each level costs 1.5x more.

165.name: Art of the Bail Unlocked
165.description: 1 once bought from the Garbage Tuna's shop on Trash Island. Lets you buy the bribe The Art of the Bail.

166.name: Rando Island Loot Upgrade
166.description: Level of the Rando Island upgrade that gives +5% random event boss loot per level. Bought with Bottles; each level costs 1.5x more.

167.name: Rando Island Double Boss Upgrade
167.description: Level of the Rando Island upgrade that gives +3% chance per level for a second boss when a random event boss spawns on the islands. Bought with Bottles; each level costs 1.6x more.

168.name: Rando Island Weekly Event Done
168.description: 1 once this week's free random event boss has appeared on Rando Island. Set back to 0 at the weekly reset.

169.name: Unlocked Islands
169.description: Islands you've unlocked, as letters: _ Trash, a Rando, b Crystal, c Seasalt, d Shimmer, e Fractal. Each map is bought with Bottles.

170.name: Docks Bottle Days
170.description: Days of bottles piled up at the docks. Goes up each day; picking up a bottle sets it back to 0. Up to 16 bottles show.

171.name: Crystal Island Crystal Days
171.description: Days of crystals piled up on Crystal Island, up to 14. Visiting the island spawns crystal monsters for them and sets it back to 0.

172.name: Shimmer Island DPS Record
172.description: Best damage per second on the Shimmer Island DPS dummy. Counts for the Tome and for one talent's all-stat bonus.

173.name: Shimmers
173.description: Shimmers held. Earned from Shimmer Island's weekly challenge and spent on Shimmer upgrades.

174.name: Shimmer Upgrade - Base STR

177.description: Level of the Shimmer Island upgrade "+Base LUK". Bought with Shimmers.

178.description: Level of the Shimmer Island upgrade "+% Total DMG". Bought with Shimmers.

179.description: Level of the Shimmer Island upgrade "+% Class EXP". Bought with Shimmers.

181.description: Your best score in this week's Shimmer Island challenge. Claiming gives up to 40 Shimmers based on it. Set back to 0 at the weekly reset.

182.description: 1 once you've claimed this week's Shimmer Island challenge reward. Set back to 0 at the weekly reset.

183.description: Which of the 22 weekly challenges Shimmer Island shows this week. Rerolled at the weekly reset to a different one.

184.name: Fractal Isle AFK Hours
184.description: Hours of "Nothing" AFK you've claimed. Fractal Isle bonuses unlock at 24, 200, 750, 2,500, 10,000, 20,000, 40,000 and 60,000 hours.

185.description: Which character's turn it is in this week's Weekly Battle (0 is the first character). Once it reaches your character count, every character has had a turn.

186.name: Weekly Battle Damage
186.description: Damage dealt to the current Weekly Battle boss. Each time it reaches the boss's HP the boss is beaten and the extra carries over.

187.name: Weekly Battle Boss Kills
187.description: How many times you've beaten this week's Weekly Battle boss (0 to 5). The boss gets more HP after each kill; 5 ends the battle.

188.name: Trophies
188.description: Trophies held, spent in the Weekly Battle shop. Earned by beating the boss more times than before this week.

189.name: Weekly Battle Best Kills
189.description: Most Weekly Battle boss kills reached this week (0 to 5). New bests give Trophies, and one talent gives drop rate per kill. Set back to 0 each week.

190.name: Weekly Battle Restart Used
190.description: 1 once you've restarted this week's Weekly Battle. Set it to 0 to allow another restart; it also goes back to 0 each week.

191.name: Weekly Battle Week
191.description: The week number the current Weekly Battle belongs to. When the real week changes, the battle starts fresh with a new boss.

192.name: Metal Detector Nugget Count
192.description: Small nuggets dug since your last biggest nugget in Gaming. With the Equinox upgrade Metal Detector, each one makes nuggets bigger; a new biggest nugget sets it back to 0.

193.description: Random event bosses beaten since your last meal upgrade. With the Equinox upgrade Food Lust, each stack lowers meal upgrade costs (up to its level). Upgrading a meal sets it back to 0.

194.name: Spirit Portal Restored
194.description: 1 once you've given the Spirit Diamond to the bird in the magma rivertown, which powers the portal to World 6.

195.name: Boss Gem Counter
195.description: Counts boss fights started today. Bosses can drop gems only while it's under 600. Set back to 0 each day.

196.name: Blue Tome Pages Used
196.description: 1 once you've dropped 2 Blue Tome Pages on the Tome, which adds a new Tome bonus type.

197.name: Red Tome Pages Used
197.description: 1 once you've dropped 7 Red Tome Pages on the Tome, which adds another Tome bonus type.

198.name: Most Money Held in Storage
198.description: The most money you've ever had in storage. Counts for the Tome.

199.name: Arcade Jackpots Hit
199.description: Jackpots hit in the Arcade. Each one also gives 2,000 gems. Counts for the Tome.

200.name: Highest Drop Rate Multi (Tome)

201.name: Best Spiketrap Surprise Round (Tome)
201.description: Best round reached in the Spiketrap Surprise minigame.

202.description: Best Crystal mob spawn chance per kill you've had, as a fraction (like 0.001). The Tome's "Average kills for a Crystal Spawn" is 1 divided by this.

203.name: Most DMG Dealt to Gravestone in a Weekly Battle (Tome)
203.description: Most damage dealt to the Gravestone in a weekly boss battle. The Gravestone shows up once all weekly bosses are beaten.

204.description: Most kills in one Killroy run on a Warrior.

205.name: Highest Killroy Score on an Archer (Tome)
205.description: Most kills in one Killroy run on an Archer.

206.name: Highest Killroy Score on a Mage (Tome)
206.description: Most kills in one Killroy run on a Mage.

207.name: Fastest Chaotic Efaunt Kill (Tome)
207.description: Fastest Chaotic Efaunt kill, stored as 1000 minus the seconds it took. Higher is faster.
207.warning: The Tome system uses 1000 - this value

208.name: Most Spore Caps Held at Once (Tome)
208.description: Most Spore Caps you've held in your inventory at once. Checked when the Tome is opened.

209.name: Best Non Duplicate Goblin Gorefest Wave (Tome)
209.description: Best wave reached in Goblin Gorefest (Worship) with no wizard type placed twice. Values over 160 are set to 120 on load.

210.name: Highest Immortal Snail LV (Tome)
210.description: Highest level your Immortal Snail has reached in Gaming.

211.name: Largest Oak Log Printer Sample (Tome)
211.description: Largest Oak Log sample you've taken for the 3D Printer.

212.name: Largest Copper Ore Printer Sample (Tome)
212.description: Largest Copper Ore sample you've taken for the 3D Printer.

213.name: Largest Spore Cap Printer Sample (Tome)
213.description: Largest Spore Cap sample you've taken for the 3D Printer.

214.name: Largest Goldfish Printer Sample (Tome)
214.description: Largest Goldfish sample you've taken for the 3D Printer.

215.name: Largest Fly Printer Sample (Tome)
215.description: Largest Fly sample you've taken for the 3D Printer.

216.name: Giants Killed This Week
216.description: Giant monsters killed this week. Set back to 0 at the weekly reset; feeds Most Giants Killed in a Single Week (217).

217.name: Most Giants Killed in a Single Week (Tome)
217.description: Most giant monsters killed in one week (the best value of 216).

218.name: Fastest Time to Kill 200 Tremor Wurms (Tome)
218.description: Fastest time to kill 200 Tremor Wurms, stored as 1000 minus the seconds it took. Higher is faster.

219.name: Highest Crop OG (Tome)
219.description: Highest OG level any crop has reached in Farming. The Tome shows 2 to the power of this.

220.name: Fastest Time Reaching Round 100 Arena (Tome)
220.description: Fastest time to reach round 100 in the Arena, stored as 1000 minus the seconds it took. Higher is faster.
220.warning: The Tome system uses 1000 - this value

221.name: Largest Magic Bean Trade (Tome)
221.description: Most Magic Beans you've got from one trade with the Legumulyte.

222.name: Most Balls Earned from LBoFaF (Tome)
222.description: Most balls earned from one round of Lava's Ballpit of Fire and Fury, the Arcade bonus round.

223.name: Tome Score Sent Today
223.description: 3 once today's Tome score was sent to the server; set back to 0 each day.

224.name: Most Greenstacks in Storage (Tome)
224.description: Most Greenstacks (10 million or more of one item) you've had in your storage chest.

225.name: W5 Miniboss Days
225.description: Days stacked up for the World 5 miniboss, Domeo Magmus. +1 each day; more days drop more boulders (up to 6), each one spawns a Domeo Magmus. Set to 0 when the fight starts.

226.description: Days stacked up for the World 6 miniboss, Demented Spiritlord. +1 each day; more days mean more of them in the fight (up to 6). Set to 0 when the fight starts.

229.description: Times you bought the Skull Shop's Crop Evolution Chance boost. Bonus is 1 + 9n/(300+n) times.

230.description: Times you bought the Skull Shop's Jade Gain boost. Bonus is 1 + 2n/(300+n) times.

231.name: Sneaking Mastery Difficulty
231.description: The Sneaking Mastery difficulty you're on (0 = normal). You can switch any time, up to the highest you've unlocked (232). Higher gives more Jade and Sneaking EXP, and harder floors.

232.description: Highest Sneaking Mastery tier you've unlocked, by clearing all 12 floors on your current top difficulty. Each tier adds a Mastery bonus.

233.name: Gemstones - Aquamarine
233.description: Aquamarine Gemstones added to your Sneaking collection (Ninja Knowledge). Its bonus (Stealth for all Ninjas) grows with more, with diminishing returns.

234.name: Gemstones - Malachite
234.description: Malachite Gemstones added to your Sneaking collection (Ninja Knowledge). Its bonus (Jade Gain) grows with more, with diminishing returns.

235.name: Gemstones - Garnet
235.description: Garnet Gemstones added to your Sneaking collection (Ninja Knowledge). Its bonus (Damage to Doors) grows with more, with diminishing returns.

236.name: Gemstones - Starite
236.description: Starite Gemstones added to your Sneaking collection (Ninja Knowledge). Its bonus (Gold Charm Bonus) grows with more, with diminishing returns.

237.name: Gemstones - Topaz
237.description: Topaz Gemstones added to your Sneaking collection (Ninja Knowledge). Its bonus (Sneak EXP Gain) grows with more, with diminishing returns.

238.name: Gemstones - Moissanite
238.description: Moissanite Gemstones added to your Sneaking collection (Ninja Knowledge). Its bonus (bonuses from the other Gemstones) grows with more, with diminishing returns.

239.description: Emerald Gemstones added to your Sneaking collection (Ninja Knowledge). Its bonus (Cheaper Upgrades) grows with more, with diminishing returns.

240.description: Firefrost gemstones you've added to your Ninja Knowledge collection. More of them raise the gem's Charm level bonus.

242.description: Your best Hoops score. The game shows it as "Best" once it reaches 11.

243.description: 1 after a Hoops game until its cooldown (slot 423) runs out, and 0 again at the daily reset. While 0, the Hoops invite can pop up.

244.description: Set to 1 when a level 20+ character turns down the Hoops invite; back to 0 at the weekly reset. Nothing in the game reads it.

245.description: 1 once the "!" next to the party kill bar has shown for 12 seconds. The bar appears when 2 or more party members are on the same map.

246.name: New Player Map Hints Shown
246.description: How far the one-time pointer hints on the first maps have got (1, 2, 14, 16, 19, 24, 26). Each map shows its hint once, then raises this to its step.

247.description: 1 once you've paid 250 coins to build the storage chest in the World 1 town. It's offered when any character reaches level 7; at 0 the chest is hidden.

252.name: Weekly Dealz Gift Claimed
252.description: 1 once you've claimed the free gift box (a cape, ring, nametag and a hat you pick) that can pop up in the Steam (desktop) version during the WeeklyDealz event. It never shows again after.

254.description: Upgrade level. +1 feather per second per level; at 0 no feathers come in. Reset by Feather Restart and Mega Reset.

255.description: Upgrade level. Each level raises one of six permanent bonuses in turn: Class XP, Base Damage, Total Damage, Skill XP, Drop Rate, All Stats. Never reset.

256.description: Upgrade level. +5% feather generation per level. Reset by Feather Restart and Mega Reset.

257.description: Upgrade level. Makes all of Orion's upgrades cheaper (10% per level, diminishing). Reset by Feather Restart and Mega Reset.

261.description: Upgrade level. Makes all of Orion's upgrades cheaper (20% per level, diminishing). Reset by Feather Restart and Mega Reset.

262.description: Times you've done The Great Mega Reset. Each of the first 9 Megafeathers unlocks a perk; more raise Orion's bonuses further. Never reset.

265.name: Orion Found
265.description: 1 once you've found Orion. Shows Orion's map (42) on the world map.

266.name: Poppy Found
266.description: 1 once you've found Poppy. Shows Poppy's button in Orion's menu and her map (73) on the world map.

267.name: Poppy - Bluefin Fish
267.description: Bluefin fish you have to spend on upgrades. Big values like 5e50 are fine.

268.name: Poppy - Tasty Fishbait
268.description: Upgrade level. Each level adds 10 bluefin per catch; fishing starts at level 1.

269.name: Poppy - Quick Reeling
269.description: Upgrade level. Bluefin catches come 5% faster per level.

270.name: Poppy - Shiny Lure
270.description: Upgrade level. Shiny fishing speed; at 0 no shiny fish are caught.

271.name: Poppy - Bonuses from Poppy
271.description: Upgrade level. Gives permanent bonuses in the real game (fishing XP, accuracy, damage, AFK gains, cash and more). Never reset.

272.name: Poppy - Fishy Discount
272.description: Upgrade level. Bluefin upgrades cost 10% less per level (diminishing).

273.name: Poppy - Juicy Worm
273.description: Upgrade level. Each level adds 50 bluefin per catch.

274.name: Poppy - Fisheroo Reset
274.description: How many Fisheroo Resets you have done. Each one costs 20x more.

275.name: Poppy - Fishing Buddy
275.description: Upgrade level. More bluefin per catch (up to level 5, more past 5 after the 6th Megafish).

276.name: Poppy - Lightning Quickness
276.description: Upgrade level. Shiny catches come 4% faster per level.

277.name: Poppy - Fisheroo Investing
277.description: Upgrade level. Each level gives 1 more Reset Point per Fisheroo Reset.

278.name: Poppy - Multihook Fishing
278.description: Upgrade level. Each level adds 200 bluefin per catch.

279.name: Poppy - Greatest Catch
279.description: Megafish caught. Each of the first 12 unlocks a perk (Tar Pit, bigger bonuses); past 12 each one raises Poppy's bonuses again.

280.name: Poppy - Bluefin Caught This Run
280.description: Bluefin caught since the last Fisheroo Reset. Shown in the Poppy menu.

287.name: Poppy - Tar Pit Open
287.description: 1 while the Poppy menu shows the Tar Pit, 0 for the bluefin pond. Needs 1 Megafish.

288.name: Poppy - Bluefin Catch Timer
288.description: Seconds toward the next bluefin catch. Fills while fishing and from AFK time.

289.name: Poppy - Shiny Catch Timer
289.description: Progress toward the next shiny fish catch. Fills while fishing and from AFK time.

290.name: Poppy - Reset Points
290.description: Unspent Reset Points for the Reset Spirals. Earned by Fisheroo Reset, cleared by Greatest Catch.

291.name: Poppy - Reset Spiral: Bluefin Caught
291.description: Reset Spiral level. Each level: +40% bluefin caught.

292.name: Poppy - Reset Spiral: Shiny Speed and Luck
292.description: Reset Spiral level. Each level: +30% shiny fishing speed and luck.

293.name: Poppy - Reset Spiral: Cheaper Upgrades
293.description: Reset Spiral level. Each level: all upgrades 15% cheaper.

294.name: Poppy - Reset Spiral: Other Spirals Stronger
294.description: Reset Spiral level. Each level: the other spirals 4% stronger.

295.name: Poppy - Reset Spiral: Tartar Caught
295.description: Reset Spiral level. Each level: +20% tartar fish caught.

296.name: Poppy - Tartar Fish
296.description: Tartar fish you have to spend on Tar Pit upgrades. Reset by Fisheroo Reset.

297.name: Poppy - Super Yummy Bait
297.description: Tar Pit upgrade level. Each level adds 100 bluefin per catch.

298.name: Poppy - Bonus Catching
298.description: Tar Pit upgrade level. More shiny fish per shiny catch.

299.name: Poppy - Bluefin Frenzy
299.description: Tar Pit upgrade level. +8% bluefin caught per level.

300.name: Poppy - Fishy Reductions
300.description: Tar Pit upgrade level. Bluefin upgrades cost 15% less per level (diminishing).

301.name: Poppy - Super Tarbait
301.description: Tar Pit upgrade level. Tartar fish come 5% faster per level.

302.name: Poppy - Tarrific Resets
302.description: Tar Pit upgrade level. Each level gives 1 more Reset Point per Fisheroo Reset.

303.name: Poppy - Mongo Multipliers
303.description: Tar Pit upgrade level. Multipliers show up more often in shiny fishing.

304.name: Poppy - King Worm
304.description: Tar Pit upgrade level. Each level adds 1000 bluefin per catch; after the 11th Megafish all upgrades get 5% cheaper per level.

305.name: Poppy - Tartar Catch Timer
305.description: Seconds toward the next tartar fish. Fills after the first Megafish, also from AFK time.

306.name: Land Rank Bars Hidden
306.description: Checkbox in the Land Rank menu. 1 hides the land rank bars drawn on your farm plots, 0 shows them.

307.name: Land Rank Reset Used
307.description: 1 once you have reset your Land Rank upgrades this week. Goes back to 0 at the weekly reset.

308.description: Which option you voted for in this week's ballot: 1 to 3, or 0 if you have not voted. Goes back to 0 when a new voting week starts.

309.name: Ballot Vote Week
309.description: The voting week of your last ballot vote (game time divided by one week). When it no longer matches the current week, your vote is cleared.

310.name: Event Points
310.description: Event Points to spend in the Event Shop. You get them from Event Point items and event minigame rewards; unspent points carry over.

311.name: Event Shop Items Owned
311.description: The Event Shop items you own, one letter per item (the shop has 68 items). Change it on the Event Shop page.

312.name: Villager Info Hints Seen
312.description: Which villager's info button still blinks in the Villagers menu. Opening that villager's info panel moves it on to the next villager.

313.name: Opal Investing Opened
313.description: 1 once you have opened the opal investing panel in the Villagers menu. Until then its button blinks whenever you have opals to invest.

314.name: Unused
314.description: Not read or written by the game.

315.name: Gold Pocketwatch Day Skip
315.description: 1 after you use a Gold Pocketwatch. The next daily reset then skips the shop restock and the other daily refills, and sets this back to 0.

316.name: Bravery Defeat Warning Seen
316.description: 1 after your first defeat at the Bravery Monument. That first time the game warns that a defeat keeps no bonuses and gives you another try.

317.name: Gem Shop Opals Bought Today
317.description: Opals bought from the Gem Shop today. At 4 you can't buy more until the daily reset.

318.description: Layers cleared today in the skilling caverns (Motherlode, Undying Hive, Evertree, Trench), counted together. At 6 they refuse more until the daily reset.

319.description: Endless Summoning fights won. The endless win bonuses and several summoning upgrades are worked out from this number, and later endless fights get harder.

320.name: Equinox Pengy Count
320.description: How many pengies you have. Each one adds 10% to the Equinox bar fill rate, and that many Pingy critters walk around one map.

321.name: Summoning High Performance
321.description: Switch in the summoning battle screen. 1 hides the damage numbers that pop up when you click enemies.

322.name: Bundle Popup Skips
322.description: Bundle offer popups stay hidden while this is above 0. It goes down by 1 each time you press Play, and is set to 1 when every character was away for 30+ days.

323.name: Supreme Wiring Days
323.description: Days counted for the Supreme Wiring event-shop bonus: +2% printer output per day, up to 50. Taking a new printer sample resets it to 0.

324.name: Cosmic Balls
324.description: Cosmic Balls for the Arcade Shop. Spend them on a level 100 upgrade to double its bonus.

325.name: Event Plays Left

326.name: Event Extra Plays Bought Today
326.description: 1 once you have bought extra event plays with gems today ("Come Back Tomorrow!"). Goes back to 0 at the daily reset.

327.description: 1 once you have used the Worship Floppy Discs, which unlocks Save/Load for all Worship runs. Until then worship monsters can drop the discs.

328.name: Worship Cannoli Multiplier
328.description: The Cannoli meal's Tower Defence points multiplier when you last started a worship run. If the meal bonus changed, starting a run rescales the saved totem points to match.

329.name: Grimoire - total bones collected

330.name: Grimoire - current bone1 (femur)
330.description: Femur bones you have, spent on Grimoire upgrades.

331.name: Grimoire - current bone2 (ribcage)
331.description: Ribcage bones you have, spent on Grimoire upgrades.

332.name: Grimoire - current bone3 (cranium)
332.description: Cranium bones you have, spent on Grimoire upgrades.

333.name: Grimoire - current bone4 (bovinae)
333.description: Bovinae bones you have, spent on Grimoire upgrades.

334.description: Targets beaten in order for the Grimoire's Knockout! upgrade, one stack each (78 targets). Each stack adds Wraith damage.

335.name: Grimoire - elimination! stacks
335.description: Targets beaten in order for the Grimoire's Elimination! upgrade, one stack each (78 targets). Each stack adds Wraith damage.

336.name: Grimoire - annihilation! stacks
336.description: Targets beaten in order for the Grimoire's Annihilation! upgrade, one stack each (78 targets). Each stack adds Wraith damage.

337.name: Ribbon Shelf Unlocked
337.description: 1 unlocks the Ribbon Shelf. Set when you get your first ribbon: a Gem Shop ribbon, a cooking ribbon, or opening the event wheel during the "ValOn" event.

338.name: Vault Knockout! Progress
338.description: Targets beaten in order for the Upgrade Vault's Knockout! upgrade (78 targets). Each adds total damage.

345.description: Lifetime fish caught. The Upgrade Vault's Schoolin' the Fish gives class EXP based on it.

369.name: Emperor Showdown Level

370.description: Entries left for Emperor (negative number, goes up to 0)

372.name: Achievement Progress Tracker
372.description: Achievement system tracking for progression monitoring
